{"blocks":[{"key":"avs2i","text":"For fresh tissue: ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":18}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"8st1o","text":"Place sample into a sterile glass homogenizer.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"84l2s","text":"Add 0.375 mL of extraction buffer, and gently homogenise the tissue. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"7ielc","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"ann0a","text":"For frozen homogenized tissue samples (in 1.5 mL tubes): ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":57}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"6n948","text":"Add 0.375 mL of the extraction buffer to the tube. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"8a891","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"33mqh","text":"For frozen whole tissue samples (in 1.5 mL tubes): ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":51}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"ett6b","text":"Add 0.375 mL of the extraction buffer to the tube. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"fivbb","text":"Pour buffer and sample into homogeniser and homogenise. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"e0jp0","text":"Use 1000 µL pipette to transfer everything back into original tube.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"2u6dk","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"7970b","text":"For water samples on filter paper (in 1.5 mL tubes): ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"bold","offset":0,"length":53}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"47t3a","text":"Add 0.375 mL of the extraction buffer to the tube. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"5da05","text":"You may want to add more to cover all filter paper.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}},{"key":"366v4","text":"","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"594q3","text":"Briefly vortex and incubate at 37°C using an incubator or heat block for 30 min. This allows the lysozyme to digest bacterial cell walls - particularly gram positive cells which have a high proportion of peptidoglycan. ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"ctpsg","text":"Add 10 µL of 20 mg/mL Proteinase K to digest proteins. The 1% SDS in the solution enhances proteinase K activity.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"bmhis","text":"Add ~50 mg of sterile glass beads.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"593jf","text":"Process in Tissue Lyser at max speed (30 shakes/s) for 30 seconds to break apart the cells.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"5lva3","text":"Incubate in 65°C incubator/heat block for 1 hour.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"e784o","text":"Remove samples and change setting to 37°C.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"5dfgr","text":"Add 90 µL of 5 M KOAc.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"bh7ia","text":"Incubate on ice for 30 minutes.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"6f33m","text":"Centrifuge at 15000xg for 15 minutes at 4°C (tab up).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"3l6c4","text":"Transfer supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube. If much floating material remains, re-spin for 15 minutes (avoid the pelleted protein).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"afoo5","text":"Add 5 µL of 10 mg/mL RNase-A to supernatant in new tube and incubate @ 37°C in incubator/heat block for 30 minutes (leave heat block on afterwards).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"8m16i","text":"Add 500 µL of isopropanol to precipitate.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"8a3ht","text":"Mix gently and let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"6pdm","text":"Centrifuge at 15000xg for 15 minutes at 4°C (tab up).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"d46n6","text":"Carefully remove supernatant with pipette (position the tip opposite the tab side). Its okay to leave some supernatant behind. Don’t worry if you don’t see a pellet.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"cijic","text":"Add 150 µL of 70% ethanol to wash the DNA (apply against the tab side), and centrifuge at 15000xg for 2 mins (tab up) at 4°C.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"cq4au","text":"Carefully remove all supernatant with pipette (position tip opposite the tab side).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"7sq93","text":"Air-dry by putting the tubes in the 37˚C block from the heat block and leaving them in the laminar flow for ≥15 mins with the lids open to evaporate the alcohol.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
{"blocks":[{"key":"4td1f","text":"Add 50 µL of sterile water. Vortex then centrifuge for ~10 seconds.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

{"blocks":[{"key":"9d1na","text":"Leave overnight at 4°C to resuspend the DNA. DNA can be stored long term at -20°C.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}

Contaminated clothing must be laundered before reuse. Get medical attention if irritation develops or persists. 
Eyes: Flush immediately with large amounts of water for at least 20 minutes. Eyelids should be held away from the eyeball to ensure thorough rinsing. Do not allow victim to rub the affected eye(s). Get medical attention if irritation persists.
